Initial vehicle deliveries begin in Austin this December, though nationwide operation hinges on broader regulatory approval.

stories.title: Infrabel selects supplier for 90-locomotive framework contract
stories.summary: Infrabel selected Stadler for a framework contract covering the supply and maintenance of up to 90 locomotives to renew its engineering fleet.

stories.title: Rhein-Ruhr cities pool resources to place joint tram order
stories.summary: Škoda Group won a joint order to supply 50 low-floor trams to operators in Essen, Krefeld, and Oberhausen, with options for 29 more.

stories.title: FCC Draft Drone Order Makes 400-Foot Coverage Optional for AURA
stories.summary: The FCC votes Thursday, November 19, on an order that would let AURA Network Systems convert its 54 site-based 450 MHz licenses into one nationwide license for drone control links, with no auction and no windfall payment. The draft drops the 400-foot coverage requirement, making it optional, while keeping the nationwide license and high-altitude service.

stories.title: Humyn Labs raises $47M to collect real-world data for robotics
stories.summary: Humyn Labs raised $47 million in Series A funding to collect real-world data for robotics, having surpassed $50 million in annualized revenue within six months of operations. The round includes $26 million in equity led by Accel and $21 million in venture debt led by Lighthouse Canton, supporting deployment readiness infrastructure in Brazil, Korea, and India.

stories.title: Amazon Said Quitting Unwilling Towns 'Would Probably Not Happen'
stories.summary: Amazon withdrew its Westborough, Massachusetts, site-plan application on November 10 after the town voted 510 to 13 to ban drone launch pads. The company told the Boston Globe it will file a revised project soon, while the Zoning Board of Appeals meets December 7 to decide on a residents' appeal.

stories.title: UAV Navigation's HES01 Puts Drones on Ship Decks, if GPS Survives
Wing Flies 6 Miles Out of Ponchatoula. The City's Say Ends at the Lot
stories.summary: Wing’s Walmart drones in Ponchatoula, Louisiana, deliver up to six miles from the store, Mayor Wesley Daniels told Baton Rouge station WBRZ in a report published Monday, November 16. More than a dozen of them sit in a fenced nest in the middle of the parking lot at the Walmart off US-51.

stories.title: Ecuadorian Fishermen Sue US Over Galápagos Drone Strike That Sank Boat
stories.summary: The crew of La Negra Francisca Duarte II sued the United States government in federal court in western Pennsylvania on Monday, alleging American forces sent armed drones that sank their boat near the Galápagos Islands on March 17. The complaint lists 18 plaintiffs and seeks damages, while the Defense Department and Coast Guard have denied responsibility for the attack.

stories.title: Zipline Hires Uber Veteran For 20 African Hubs While Ghana Owes It
stories.summary: Zipline hired Anthony le Roux, a 13-year Uber executive, as its Head of Operations for Africa from January 2027 to build at least 20 new distribution centres across the continent within two years. The first 10 are agreed with Côte d’Ivoire, while Ghana’s health minister told Parliament in July that the government still owed Zipline about GH¢175 million.

stories.title: Rail Freight Fraud: Organized Crime’s New Tactic?
stories.summary: Trinity Industries CEO Bill Stephens said the railcar market is tightening as new builds run roughly 15,000 units below annual scrappage, a deficit he expects to intensify through 2027. He noted that steel prices rose 63% year over year at the end of the third quarter, reinforcing lease rate gains across the fleet.

stories.title: Event 38 Unmanned Systems and Parallax Advanced Research Collaborate to Integrate Vigilant Spirit Ground Control Station with E455 VTOL UAS
stories.summary: Event 38 Unmanned Systems and Parallax Advanced Research are collaborating to integrate the Vigilant Spirit Ground Station with Event 38’s E455 Fixed-Wing VTOL UAS. The effort demonstrates the flexibility of the E455’s open architecture and its ability to support emerging command and control technologies for defense and government applications.

stories.title: Ukraine Tests 9 DJI Mavic Replacements With a 60-Minute Flight Bar
stories.summary: Ukraine’s defense-tech cluster Brave1 and the Ministry of Defense tested Mavic-type reconnaissance drones from nine Ukrainian manufacturers. The makers whose aircraft proved combat-ready are now moving to contracts to supply military units.

stories.title: Ukraine plans to double drone supplies in 2027 and expands defence AI cooperation with Denmark
stories.summary: Ukrainian Defence Minister Evgeniy Khmara announced plans to double drone supplies in 2027, stating unmanned systems will account for more than half of the country’s weapons requirements next year. On 18 November, Ukraine and Denmark signed a letter of intent for strategic cooperation in defence AI and data, including Denmark’s entry into the Avengers Labs platform.

stories.title: From Commercial Scale to Embodied Intelligence: The Next Challenge for Robotics
stories.summary: Pudu Robotics presented its One Brain, Multiple Embodiments strategy at its European Partner Summit in Amsterdam on November 4. The company, which has shipped more than 130,000 robots across over 85 countries, introduced PuduFM and PuduAgent as core technologies for its embodied AI portfolio.

stories.title: Red Cat Withdraws 2026 Revenue Forecast as Defense Contracts Progress More Slowly Than Expected
stories.summary: Red Cat Holdings withdrew its full-year 2026 revenue forecast on November 16, citing slower-than-expected defense funding and contract awards. The company reported third-quarter revenue of $11.8 million and noted that the Pentagon’s Drone Dominance Gauntlet II competition removed an anticipated contributor to near-term revenue.

stories.title: Putnam Sheriff Pitches $312K Police Drones as Neighbors Hold Waivers
stories.summary: Putnam County Sheriff Brian Hess will pitch a $312,000 Drone as First Responder program to the Protective Services Committee on November 18, after legislators held the funds in contingency pending public briefing. The proposed 2027 budget allocates $60,000 for three Skydio drones, though Hess previously cited a plan for six drones and a $276,000 cost.

stories.title: AUVSI Names Brett Feddersen President and CEO, Succeeding Michael Robbins
stories.summary: The Association for Uncrewed Vehicle Systems International (AUVSI) named Brett Feddersen as its next President and CEO, effective December 1, 2026. Feddersen succeeds Michael Robbins, who left the organization in October to lead the Semiconductor Industry Association.

stories.title: Rockwell Automation acquiring mobile robot maker AGILOX
stories.summary: Rockwell Automation signed a definitive agreement to acquire Austria-based AGILOX, a move that will more than double the size of its autonomous mobile robot business. The deal is expected to close in the second quarter of Rockwell’s fiscal 2027, subject to regulatory approval.

stories.title: Chinese Drone Shoots Rice Seeds Into Mud, Lifts Yield 11% in Trial
stories.summary: Researchers at South China Agricultural University in Guangzhou developed a drone seeding system that shoots germinated rice into a paddy in rows, yielding 6,731 kg per hectare in a November 2025 trial. This 11% gain over conventional broadcasting drones resulted from a semi-open impeller pump that fired seed slurry in 10 Hz pulses to limit rotor downwash interference.

stories.title: Blue UAS Supplier Lantronix Says Its China Exit Has Only Started
stories.summary: Lantronix CEO Saleel Awsare told Military.com that the Irvine, California company has moved 98% of its supply chain out of China, relying on suppliers in Taiwan, Thailand, and Vietnam. Awsare stated that the process of moving production back to the United States has only just started, with printed circuit boards remaining particularly difficult to relocate.

stories.title: TU Delft Drone Feels Its Way to a Perch, Then Kills Its Motors
stories.summary: Delft University of Technology researchers published a quadcopter design that perches by touch, achieving a 99% success rate in simulations with target estimates off by up to 2 feet. The drone uses a spring-loaded, three-fingered hand to locate and grip branches, switching off its motors to conserve energy.

stories.title: Pony AI’s sales beat estimates as robotaxi business expands
stories.summary: Pony AI reported third-quarter revenue of $44.6 million, a 75% increase that exceeded analyst estimates, as robotaxi services revenue climbed 165%. The company’s fleet reached 2,768 vehicles, keeping it on track for a full-year target of 3,500, while it targets broader U.K. and European commercial rollouts in 2027.

stories.title: Schiebel's Navy Helicopter Drone Drops a Smaller Drone in Mid-Flight
stories.summary: Schiebel demonstrated its Camcopter S-100 unmanned helicopter releasing an OSIRIS HSCD-1 camera drone in forward flight in Austria. The S-100 relayed the small drone’s control link and video from the air, a capability Schiebel says can support counter-drone operations using interceptor drones.

stories.title: SkyDrive and Kyushu Electric Power Partner to Integrate eVTOLs Into Urban Development
stories.summary: SkyDrive Inc. and Kyushu Electric Power Co. signed a comprehensive partnership agreement on November 18 to study how eVTOL aircraft could fit into community planning and urban development in Japan. The companies will assess business models and regional transportation challenges, aiming to improve connectivity and revitalize local communities, though they did not disclose specific locations, routes, or timelines.

stories.title: East Texas A&M Researchers Test AI to Detect GPS Spoofing in Drones
stories.summary: Researchers at East Texas A&M University tested whether artificial intelligence can detect signs of GPS spoofing in drone flight records using a public dataset of 96 real drone flights. The study found that pretrained AI models were the best at flagging unreliable location data, with a model called Chronos scoring 97.5 percent on a measure that balances how many abnormal sequences it catches against how often its alerts are correct.

stories.title: Amazon Data: Homes Near Its Nampa Hub Average 63 to 79 Drones a Day
stories.summary: Amazon’s flight data shows that several addresses near its Nampa, Idaho, drone hub had an average of 63 to 79 Prime Air drones pass within 820 feet daily in the week of November 2 to 8. The company is looking at spreading its flight paths to reduce concentration over certain areas, though it has not specified which areas or when changes will occur.

stories.title: Amazon's Iowa Drone Hub Has One Condition: Prove the Noise Numbers
stories.summary: Bondurant, Iowa, approved a drone launch site for Amazon’s Prime Air service at the company’s DSM5 fulfillment center, with a condition that a sound study show the drones are no louder than the decibel levels Amazon presented to the city. The City Council took up the site plan on Monday, November 16, and Amazon says deliveries to the Des Moines area could begin in mid-January.

stories.title: Cruz Says Congress ‘Very Close’ to Finalizing ADS-B In Mandate
stories.summary: Senator Ted Cruz said Tuesday that Congress is “very, very close” to finalizing long-delayed airspace safety legislation. The Senate and House have “reached an agreement in principle” to mandate that all flights required to broadcast ADS-B Out transmissions also be equipped with ADS-B In.

stories.title: President opens Jakarta LRT metro extension as further expansion planned
stories.summary: President Prabowo Subianto inaugurated a 6.4 km extension of the Jakarta LRT, more than doubling the light rail line’s length by taking it from Kelapa Gading in north Jakarta to the Manggarai transport hub in the south of the conurbation. With ridership rising, the city is now planning to procure more trains and a further extension of the line.

stories.title: Matternet appoints former Joby Aviation finance leader as CFO
stories.summary: Matternet appointed Ben Dobson as Chief Financial Officer, effective immediately. Dobson joins from Joby Aviation, where he served as Head of Finance from 2021, and will oversee finance, accounting, financial planning, and investor relations as the company prepares to commercialize its M3 autonomous delivery platform.

stories.title: ZVOOK and Imperium Defense Group partner on acoustic counter-UAS technology in the US
stories.summary: Ukrainian defence technology company ZVOOK signed a cooperation agreement with US-based Imperium Defense Group (IDG) to develop opportunities for acoustic early-warning and tracking systems in the United States. IDG will lead market development and customer engagement, while ZVOOK will provide product documentation, training and technical support for agreed activities.

stories.title: EU-funded Di-PEGASUS project concludes after three years of drone integration research
stories.summary: The EU-funded Di-PEGASUS project concluded after three years of research on integrating drones and advanced air mobility into European airspace. Its final event in Rome on 5 November 2026 presented findings from partners including Collins Aerospace and Capgemini Portugal, identifying physical integration, sustainable business models, and public engagement as central to development.

stories.title: UK to supply Ukraine with more than 1,000 air defence missiles to counter Russian drones
stories.summary: The UK announced a GBP 240 million package on 17 November to supply Ukraine with more than 1,000 short-range air defence missiles and launchers, alongside more than a dozen radars. Deliveries are expected to begin in mid-December, with missiles supplied by Thales Belfast and radars sourced from the UK and Europe.

stories.title: FlytBase launches Octane as autonomous drones become everyday infrastructure for oil and gas
stories.summary: FlytBase launched Octane, a platform for oil and gas companies to build enterprise drone programs by combining software, engineering support, and regional deployment capabilities. The system helps companies repeat successful drone operations across sites and countries, addressing challenges in hardware, aviation approvals, and data workflows.

stories.title: Doroni Aerospace Raises More than $60m for H1‑X Development
‘We want to bridge the gap between the tourism and rail sectors', says Pegasus Trains
stories.summary: French operator Pegasus Trains secured three years of paths to run dedicated overnight charters for European tour companies to destinations in the French Alps.

stories.title: Elroy Air lands $70 million deal for 20 autonomous cargo drones
stories.summary: Elroy Air signed a purchase agreement with Abu Dhabi-based Barq Group for up to 20 Chaparral autonomous cargo aircraft, valued at up to $70 million. Barq Group placed five firm orders backed by a $10.25 million deposit and reserved slots for 15 more, with deliveries scheduled to begin in 2027.

stories.title: Every second Russian drone launched overnight is a jet-powered one: how many destroyed
stories.summary: Russia launched 141 drones, including 73 jet-powered ones, during the night of November 18. Air defenses destroyed or suppressed 126 unmanned aerial vehicles, while seven hits were recorded.

stories.title: Uber, Zoox launch autonomous ride-hailing service in Las Vegas
Federal Register Public Inspection Lists Proposed Rule on Airspace Designations and Reporting Points for Naples, FL
stories.summary: The FAA proposed a rule on airspace designations and reporting points for Naples, FL, which is scheduled to appear in the Federal Register on November 18, 2026.

stories.title: U.S. Army Upgrading Abrams Tanks With New Defensive Drone System
Urban rail industry news round-up
stories.summary: Bengaluru’s Namma Metro network reached 104 km with the opening of the first section of the Pink Line on November 14. Helsinki area transport operator Pääkaupunkiseudun Kaupunkiliikenne signed a contract for Stadler to supply 63 Tango Nordic trams on November 11.

stories.title: Russia Forms Drone Units as Recruitment Reaches 98.7%
stories.summary: Deputy Defense Minister Viktor Goremykin announced that Russia has established drone-equipped units across all combined-arms formations and Airborne Forces, fulfilling directives from Defense Minister Andrey Belousov. As of November 18, recruitment for the Unmanned Systems Forces reached 98.7% of the 2026 target, while overall contract soldier recruitment hit 89.3%.

stories.title: Starlink Ukraine Speed Limit Cuts Drone Links, Kyiv Says; NATO’s Rutte Names No One Responsible
stories.summary: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte said Tuesday in Brussels that relevant parties are working to restore normal Starshield and Starlink service for Ukraine, but he named no one responsible for the speed limit that Kyiv says cuts off terminals moving faster than 100 mph (161 km/h). Ukrainian officials say that one speed setting on a government-linked satellite service now disables their interceptor drones, while parties on record point in different directions about who controls it.

stories.title: Ottawa defence company develops non-explosive anti-drone missiles
stories.summary: Ottawa defence company A.I.RShare is shipping approximately 50 Overwatch interceptor missiles weekly to customers in the United States and overseas conflict zones. The one-kilogram missiles travel at Mach 1.4 and release latex strands to disable drones without explosives or direct contact.

stories.title: Ukraine, Germany to launch joint production of unmanned ground systems – Pistorius
stories.summary: German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius announced a new German-Ukrainian joint venture to manufacture unmanned ground vehicles in Germany for Ukraine. The plan combines German manufacturing capabilities with Ukrainian technological solutions and combat experience.

stories.title: Tesla Cybercab crashes: 8 reports, ADS and ADAS
stories.summary: Electrek reported eight Tesla Cybercab crash records from August and September 2026, split evenly between ADS and ADAS categories. The four ADS reports were in Austin; Electrek says none involved injuries. The four ADAS reports came from Philadelphia, Austin, Lehi, and Tampa; two include injury entries. Electrek says system engagement within the 30-second reporting window does not establish crash causation.

stories.title: Hanwha Systems to test-export short-range drone radars to US sites
stories.summary: Hanwha Systems signed a test-export deal with Rebellion Industries to supply short-range AESA radars to U.S. civilian sites, including oil refineries and stadiums, by early 2027. The 10 km detection range radars are designed to track low-altitude drones and small unmanned aerial vehicles, distinguishing them from birds and other aircraft using AI-powered identification.

also.title: Hanwha Systems wins first US deal for drone-detection radar

stories.title: Miracom Inc, Rainbow Robotics team up on RX integrated services for manufacturing
stories.summary: Miracom Inc signed a partnership with Rainbow Robotics on Nov. 18 to jointly pursue RX projects spanning robot introduction, system integration, deployment, and operations. The companies plan to combine Rainbow Robotics' robots with Miracom's MES and application software to provide integrated services for manufacturing customers.

stories.title: Bend, Oregon Operator Direct2 Trades as Beeline UAS and Joins Matternet's Part 135 Drone Delivery Network
stories.summary: Direct2, an air operator based in Bend, Oregon, also trades as Beeline UAS and joined Matternet's network of Part 135 drone delivery operators in 2026. The company applies its FAA Part 135 air carrier authority to commercial drone delivery, operating alongside Ameriflight and UPS Flight Forward.

stories.title: California’s Newly Headless Zombie Bullet Train Lurches On
stories.summary: Ian Choudri, CEO of California’s High-Speed Rail Authority, resigned on October 28, 2026, following an inspector general report that the agency paid nearly $600,000 in unallowable travel expenses to questionable locations. Joe Stephenshaw, director of California’s Department of Finance, is now managing the project.

stories.title: Kuwait reports drone attacks as Iran, US trade attacks on Qeshm and Bahrain
stories.summary: Kuwait's army reported drone attacks on Tuesday as the United States and Iran traded strikes on Qeshm island and Bahrain. The US hit a missile launch site on Qeshm after Iran targeted a US radar system in Bahrain, while three oil tankers struck naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Kuwait, Bahrain Issue Fresh Alert Over Hostile Drones As US-Iran War Flares Anew
stories.summary: Kuwait’s army said its air defense systems are countering drone attacks, while Bahrain’s Ministry of Interior issued an alert about a potential threat, as tensions between the United States and Iran flared again.

also.title: Kuwait military says 'countering hostile drone attacks'

CASA Seeks Feedback on Draft Guidance for Powered-Lift Aircraft Certification
stories.summary: Australia's Civil Aviation Safety Authority (CASA) is seeking feedback on a draft advisory circular outlining a performance-based certification approach for powered-lift aircraft. The draft guidance, which is not a binding rule, aims to help industry understand available certification pathways before finalization.

stories.title: Tesla Adds 200 Cybercabs in a Day as Texas Registry Passes 1,500 Vehicles
stories.summary: Tesla added 200 Cybercabs to Texas’ registry of automated vehicles on Tuesday, lifting its registered fleet in the state past 1,500 for the first time. The Texas Department of Motor Vehicles listed 1,507 vehicles under Tesla Robotaxi LLC’s automated vehicle authorization on Tuesday evening, up from 1,306.

stories.title: Why Autonomous Vehicle Crashes Keep Misleading The Public
stories.summary: The article argues that public panic over autonomous vehicle crashes is misplaced, citing safety data from Phoenix and San Francisco that shows a high percentage of collisions occur when driverless cars are stopped or moving legally. It contends that human drivers, not the technology, are usually at fault for rear-ending or side-swiping these vehicles.

stories.title: Beyond the Race to Zero – The USA’s FPV Drone Industry just got put on notice – Twice on the same Day
stories.summary: The United States Army posted a special notice on SAM.gov inviting industry to the sUAS Manufacturing Rodeo, setting a strict maximum price of $3000 USD for a Group 1 first-person view (FPV) one-way attack (OWA) drone. The Army updated the notice on Monday, 16 November, shortening the response date from Friday, 20 November, to Wednesday, 18 November, at one in the afternoon Central time.

stories.title: Mexican Drone Sector Eyes Trade Body to Modernize Airspace Rules
stories.summary: Mexican drone industry stakeholders must establish a formal trade association to engage federal aviation and regulatory authorities. This body would allow operators to petition for standardized operational frameworks and represent interests in spectrum allocation proceedings.

stories.title: Ukraine Wants to Double Drone Production and Strengthen Air Defense with the Help of Partners
stories.summary: Ukraine’s Defense Minister Yevhen Khmara stated that the country aims to double drone production and strengthen air defense with partner support following the 37th “Ramstein” meeting. He proposed an exchange where partners transfer Patriot and IRIS-T missiles from their stockpiles in return for Ukrainian-contracted ammunition, seeking to accelerate delivery times.

stories.title: Army kicks off ‘manufacturing rodeo’ with focus on small drones
stories.summary: The Army announced it will select companies to build 400 Group 1 one-way attack drones and 20 ground combat stations each by March 1. Ten percent of the drones and ground stations must be delivered by Feb. 15 for testing and operator training.

stories.title: A 6,500-nautical-mile drone submarine built to lay mines with nobody aboard is about to reach the Navy as the third of three prototypes, nine years after the program began, and the officer running it says the plan now is to find out what it really does well and wh
Drone wreckage found in Moldova, 50 meters from the border with Ukraine
stories.summary: Wreckage from an unmanned aerial vehicle was found on the evening of November 17 near Naslavcea in Moldova’s Ocnița District, about 50 meters from the border with Ukraine. The border police reported this, Newsmaker reported, and European Pravda writes.

stories.title: California bans Waymo robotaxis from state freeways after construction zone and CHP incidents
stories.summary: The California Department of Motor Vehicles banned Waymo robotaxis from state freeways effective November 11, citing an imminent hazard to public safety after vehicles entered active construction closures on US-101 and Highway 280. Waymo has paused all freeway operations while continuing surface street service, which handles more than 500,000 trips per week.

stories.title: Ukrainian Drones Target 2 Oil Refineries Deep Inside Russia
stories.summary: Ukraine reported drone strikes against Gazprom Neftekhim Salavat and Bashneft-Ufaneftekhim, two refineries deep inside Russia. The Bashkortostan emergencies committee said more than 50 drones were downed over Ufa and Salavat, while Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Novak stated that relevant agencies must make every effort to meet domestic demand.

stories.title: Learn how AI is changing supply chain robotics
stories.summary: Lior Elazary, Josip Cesic, and Jeff Mahler will present insights on supply chain robotics at a live webinar on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, at 12 P.M. ET. The session covers AI integration for predictive analytics and dynamic routing, with a recording available for registered attendees who cannot attend live.

Transcontinental merger of Union Pacific and Norfolk Southern divides rail leaders
stories.summary: Union Pacific and Norfolk Southern argued on their third-quarter 2026 earnings calls that their proposed merger would lower supply-chain costs and help railroads win freight from trucks. CPKC demanded rejection by the Surface Transportation Board, while CSX emphasized partnerships and CN highlighted an agreement intended to protect its business. The Surface Transportation Board is expected to render a decision in 2027.

stories.title: CiS Delivers ORKA Dock Autonomous Launch And Recovery System To Defense Customer
stories.summary: CiS delivered and commissioned its ORKA Dock autonomous launch and recovery system to an undisclosed defense customer following sea acceptance testing. The customer will operate the system from an uncrewed surface vessel to support intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance missions.

stories.title: GM’s robot push raises questions about future of American autoworkers
stories.summary: General Motors plans to expand factory robot use by 20% over the next two years to improve safety, quality, and efficiency amid rising costs. The automaker is also developing autonomous robots in Indiana, a move that has raised concerns among union leaders about potential job losses ahead of 2028 contract negotiations.

stories.title: 7 drones cross into Moldovan airspace during latest Russian attack against Ukraine, 1 spotted over Chisinau
stories.summary: The Moldovan Defense Ministry reported that seven drones crossed into Moldovan airspace during a Russian attack on Nov. 17, with one Shahed-type drone spotted over Chisinau. Five drones crashed near villages including Cheltuitori, which is 10.7 kilometers from the capital, while no casualties were reported.

also.title: Seven Drones Detected Over Moldova, Five Crash Near Settlements

stories.title: Shafaq News..PM Al-Zaidi’s cabinet approves counterterrorism drone system
stories.summary: The Iraqi government approved equipping the Counter Terrorism Service with a drone system to strengthen its capabilities, Prime Minister Ali Al-Zaidi’s media office said on Tuesday. The cabinet also approved studying the establishment of a Military Engineering College in Najaf.

stories.title: Tesla Stocks Decrease 0.51% Even as Texas Robotaxi Authorizations Jump 21% in 18 Days
Russian Drones Violate Moldova’s Airspace, Triggering Closure of Six Border Crossings With Ukraine
stories.summary: Moldovan authorities suspended operations at six border checkpoints with Ukraine on November 17 after a Russian Geran-2 drone violated the country's airspace. The closures affect the Ocnița, Otaci, Unguri, Briceni, Grimăncăuți, and Clocușna crossings, while a Shahed-type drone later prompted airspace restrictions across all of Moldova.

also.title: Moldova closes six border crossing points with Ukraine following Russian drone incursion

stories.title: BRINC Launches Mobile App to Give First Responders Live Drone Video in the Field
stories.summary: BRINC launched the LiveOps iOS app on November 17, allowing authorized first responders to access live drone video and operational information directly from their iPhones and iPads. The app extends the company's existing platform to mobile devices, enabling personnel to monitor multiple drones and view real-time airspace conditions without returning to a command center.

also.title: BRINC Launches LiveOps iOS App for First Responder Drone Feeds
BRINC’s new iOS app turns iPhones and iPads into public safety drone command centers
BRINC Drones Launches New iOS App to Improve First Responder Situational Awareness

stories.title: Florida Polytechnic University Police Acquire Jetson ONE eVTOL Aircraft for Law-Enforcement Evaluation
stories.summary: Florida Polytechnic University Police Department has acquired a Jetson ONE electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) aircraft to evaluate law-enforcement operations, emergency response and aerospace research. The aircraft is registered as N911FP and nicknamed "Astro."

stories.title: The viral bullet train video is from Taiwan, not India.
stories.summary: Fact Crescendo determined a viral video claiming to show India's first bullet train is misleading, identifying it instead as footage of a new N700ST train arriving at Kaohsiung Port in Taiwan.

stories.title: Joby Aviation Falls 6% as Air Taxi Selloff Deepens; Archer Aviation Drops 4%, EHang Slides 2%
stories.summary: Joby Aviation stock fell 6% to $4.43, extending a sector-wide selloff that also pushed Archer Aviation down 4% and EHang Holdings down 2%. Joby reported $149 million in revenue against a $979 million operating loss for the 12 months ending September 30, while Archer disclosed its all-stock purchase of Wisk, Insitu, and SkyGrid from Boeing is close to completion.

stories.title: Anti-drone vehicles cleared for Raj police, ATS unit planned in Sriganganagar
stories.summary: Rajasthan police received state government approval to acquire anti-drone vehicle systems to counter cross-border intrusions. DGP Rajeev Kumar Sharma confirmed the purchase under the police modernisation budget, while police also plan to establish a dedicated anti-terrorism squad office in Sriganganagar.

stories.title: Genesee & Wyoming announces three-way split into geographically focused companies
stories.summary: Genesee & Wyoming Inc announced a plan to split into three distinct holding companies, each with its own board of directors, leadership teams and capital structures.

stories.title: MatrixSpace Portable Counter-Drone Radar Now Available On the JIATF C-UAS Marketplace.
stories.summary: MatrixSpace’s portable, radar-first counter-UAS systems are now available on the Department of Defense’s Joint Interagency Task Force 401 (JIATF-401) C-UAS Marketplace, the company announced on November 16. With the listing, government users can buy MatrixSpace systems through rapid acquisition pathways.

stories.title: Rail Research + Innovation Week 2027 Registration Opens Soon
stories.summary: The 32nd Annual AAR Research Review and IEEE VTS INNOVARail will be held in Pueblo, Colorado from May 17-20, 2027. Early bird registration for the AAR Research Review is said to open the first week of December, with paper submissions due by November 30, 2026.

stories.title: Feds should not ‘accelerate’ multi-billion-dollar high-speed Alto rail project before proper consultations, say critics
stories.summary: The federal government proposed new legislation in its 2026 budget to streamline land expropriation for the Alto high-speed rail project, which critics argue bypasses proper consultations. Critics warn the project could cost up to $113-billion and threaten agricultural land, urging a pause for independent review.

stories.title: Electric air taxis to undergo extensive testing at Orlando International Airport
stories.summary: Orlando International Airport hosted a demonstration flight of an electric air taxi earlier this month, marking the first time an electric vertical take-off and landing aircraft touched down at a commercial airport vertipad. The Greater Orlando Aviation Authority aims to open a full commercial vertiport at the airport by 2030, using the demonstration pad to determine whether the location meets operational needs.

also.title: Orlando doubles down on eVTOL airport taxis with Joby trial

stories.title: Finnish Startups Present Global RSAM Mobile Drone Manufacturing Unit
stories.summary: Three Finnish startups presented Global RSAM Mobile at Arctic Performance in Jyväskylä, Finland, on November 11, demonstrating drone-part manufacturing inside the unit for the first time. The mobile unit combines drone operations, situational awareness, on-site manufacturing, and maintenance, featuring a working CNC mill and two 3D printers to speed up repairs and reduce reliance on distant maintenance facilities.

stories.title: Why Industrial Operators Need Open Platform Ecosystems For AI-Driven Robotics
stories.summary: Amazon acquired Fauna in March, and Meta acquired Assured Robot Intelligence less than two months later. These investments suggest AI-enabled robotics is moving closer to industrial deployment.

stories.title: Most Torontonians support Waymo testing, but majority oppose driverless ride service: poll
stories.summary: Liaison Strategies found that 64 per cent of Toronto residents support Waymo testing with a human safety driver, while 51 per cent oppose paid driverless rides. The survey of 1,000 residents also showed 71 per cent would choose a human-driven vehicle over a Waymo ride at the same cost.

also.title: Most Torontonians skeptical of self-driving taxis, new poll suggests

stories.title: Sightline Intelligence Turns “Dumb” Drones Into Smart Tools
Irish Police Purchased Israeli Anti-Drone Systems, Report Says
stories.summary: Ireland's national police service, the Garda, acquired advanced military-grade drone jammers from Tel Aviv-based Sentrycs to secure Council of the European Union presidency events, contradicting August 2024 statements by then-deputy prime minister Micheál Martin that Ireland would not procure Israeli-made technology.

also.title: Irland kauft israelische Drohnenabwehr trotz Boykottpolitik

stories.title: Witron Acquires Warehouse Robotics Firm
stories.summary: Witron acquired Norwegian technology company Solwr Robotics AS to enter the autonomous warehouse robotics market. Solwr, which employs about 50 people, develops the Grab autonomous case picking robot and the Sort empty pallet sorter for retail and wholesale grocery logistics.

also.title: Dealroom.co | Witron buys Norway's Solwr Robotics to enter autonomous warehouse market

stories.title: After building Africa's largest military drone, a South African aerospace firm invites one of Europe's biggest missile manufacturers to outfit its system with weapons
stories.summary: Milkor inked a memorandum of understanding with MBDA at the Africa Aerospace and Defence 2026 exhibition in Pretoria, South Africa, to integrate MBDA missile systems onto the Milkor 380 unmanned aerial vehicle. During the exhibition, the Cape Town-made drone was fitted with two Sea Venom anti-ship missiles, each weighing 120 kg and carrying 30 kg warheads.

stories.title: Local railroad on track for $755,500 grant
Two New Commuter Trains Launched on Chattogram-Nazirhat Route
stories.summary: State Minister Mir Mohammad Helal Uddin inaugurated two new commuter train pairs on the 37-kilometer Chattogram-Nazirhat route on Tuesday. The service now offers four daily trips with seven-coach trains carrying 334 passengers, raising the minimum fare from Tk 12 to Tk 20.

stories.title: Aquiline Drones Offers New Business Model for Commercial Drone Pilots
Ukraine’s drone chief was an art dealer. A former US general says the Army should take note.
Bangladesh to Buy 30 New Locomotives to Boost Rail Freight
stories.summary: The Executive Committee of the National Economic Council approved a Tk 2,769.86 crore project to buy 30 new meter-gauge diesel-electric locomotives for Bangladesh Railway. The government will provide Tk 811.38 crore, while the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB) will lend the remaining Tk 1,958.48 crore. The project runs from July 1, 2026, to December 31, 2029, and includes spare parts, maintenance equipment, and staff training.

stories.title: Making AI deliver across track and train for future UK rail
Valkryn Emerges from Stealth to Build the Battle Lab for Robotic and Autonomous Warfare
stories.summary: Valkryn emerged from stealth to announce $17 million in total funding, including a $15 million seed round led by Andreessen Horowitz’s American Dynamism fund. The company, which builds Battle Lab technology to evaluate robotic and autonomous warfare, secured multiple funded contracts with Department of War test organizations in less than 12 months.

also.title: Valkryn Exits Stealth With $17M to Test Drones Before Combat

stories.title: US companies Seasats and Neros test Quickfish USV carrying Archer FPV drones for naval strikes
stories.summary: U.S. companies Seasats and Neros announced successful at-sea launch trials integrating Archer 10-inch Strike and Archer AI first-person-view (FPV) attack drones aboard the Quickfish unmanned surface vessel (USV). The 5.8-meter vessel reaches 40 knots, travels over 550 nautical miles, and operates at sea for up to four weeks while housing six FPV drones in an enclosed compartment.

stories.title: Airbus DS Airborne Solutions GmbH and Aeronautics Ltd. sign a Teaming Agreement intended to enable local production and support of the Orbiter 4 VTOL in Germany
stories.summary: Airbus DS Airborne Solutions GmbH and Aeronautics Ltd. signed a Teaming Agreement to establish the production and assembly of the Orbiter 4 vertical take-off and landing UAS in Germany. Aeronautics intends to transfer technological expertise and manufacturing know-how to enable local production and long-term support, with implementation subject to the conclusion of definitive agreements.

stories.title: Denmark and Ukraine sign AI drone cooperation agreement
stories.summary: Danish Defense Minister Jeppe Bruus announced Tuesday that Denmark and Ukraine signed an agreement allowing artificial intelligence development using Ukrainian battlefield drone data. The deal, which follows a broader summer cooperation, enables Denmark to test and improve domestically developed drones in conditions reflecting real military operations.

stories.title: US Military Tests Robot Hunters That Map Battlefields and Spot Targets Without GPS
stories.summary: The Pentagon's Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) tested four autonomous ground vehicles at Fort Knox, Kentucky, on 15 October 2026, to scout without GPS. A human operator supervised the robots, which used onboard sensors to map terrain and detect simulated targets, while a lead vehicle carried a drone for reconnaissance or attack. DARPA said soldiers are expected to assess the technology in December 2026, with no combat deployment announced.

stories.title: Acutronic Bets On Texas, Not Switzerland, For Drone Jet Engines
stories.summary: Acutronic plans to double its U.S. workforce over the next three years and raise output from hundreds to thousands of engines next year. The company is considering engine production in Europe, where it has sites in Germany and France.

stories.title: Another drone spotted heading toward the Botanica district. Airspace closed
stories.summary: Moldova's Ministry of Defence ordered the closure of the country's airspace at 04:27 PM after identifying a Shahed drone heading toward Chisinau's Botanica district. Police reported a suspected explosion near Cheltuitori and a drone crash near Pohorniceni, while specialists investigate the incidents.

Boston Dynamics’ Atlas humanoid lands first non-automotive trial
stories.summary: GlobalFoundries will test Boston Dynamics’ Atlas humanoid in semiconductor manufacturing tasks in early 2027, becoming the first customer outside the automotive industry to do so. The companies will identify potential applications, assess integration requirements, and begin training Atlas to perform specific tasks, though they did not disclose how many robots will be involved or which facilities will host them.

also.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas — Hyundai's Humanoid Robot Deployed to Semiconductor Factory

stories.title: A Geran-2 drone flew through Moldova’s airspace twice
stories.summary: A Geran-2 drone entered Moldova’s airspace twice on Tuesday, approaching from Ukraine’s Odesa region. The first incursion was recorded at 03:49 PM, heading toward Tiraspol, and the second at 04:02 PM, toward the village of Malaiesti in Criuleni district, IPN reports.

stories.title: Purdue Chase Plane Tailed Indiana Drone Corridor's First BVLOS Flight
stories.summary: Purdue University said on November 16 that a crewed chase plane followed its Windracers ULTRA cargo drone on October 29, during the flight that opened the Indiana Drone Corridor at Terre Haute Regional Airport. Brian Dillman, who heads Purdue’s School of Aviation and Transportation Technology, flew the chase plane himself.

stories.title: Genesis AI Raises $500M Series A to Accelerate Robot Deployment
stories.summary: Genesis AI announced a $500 million Series A on November 17, 2026, to accelerate the development and deployment of its general-purpose robots in manufacturing and logistics. The company plans to begin production and targeted customer deployments by the end of 2026, with initial customers in manufacturing, logistics, and laboratories.

Genesis AI Secures $500 Million Series A for Industrial Robot Rollout
Nvidia-backed Genesis AI raised $500 million for its humanoid robot at a $3.5 billion valuation

stories.title: Israeli firm offers drone strike kit for utility helicopters
stories.summary: Israeli loitering munition maker Uvision announced Tuesday that it is offering a kit to equip ordinary utility helicopters with its HERO-120, allowing them to launch precision strikes from a safe distance. The company will present the concept at the Loitering Munitions conference in London on Nov. 17, noting that the modular setup includes an Effector Launcher Kit and mission controls to reduce integration work.

stories.title: Gix Announces Ottonomy Autonomous Delivery Robot Joins Sheba Medical Center Fleet via deliverz.ai Platform
stories.summary: Gix Internet Ltd. announced that an Ottonomy autonomous delivery robot entered operational service at Sheba Medical Center, Israel's largest hospital, on Nov. 17, 2026. The robot joins a hybrid fleet managed through deliverz.ai’s unified orchestration platform, which coordinates robots from different manufacturers and human transport teams for centralized mission assignment and monitoring.

stories.title: Alta Ares wins NATO counter-drone framework contract
stories.summary: Alta Ares won six of 16 lots in NATO’s counter-drone marketplace, the largest number of any supplier. The company is the only supplier selected for area defense in all three configurations: fixed installations, systems that can be transported between sites, and systems that operate on the move.

stories.title: NATO’s $40 Billion Counter-Drone Imperative
stories.summary: NATO launched a counter-drone marketplace on November 5, allowing member countries to procure 16 selected solutions directly without further tender processes. The alliance announced in July that it will invest over 40 billion dollars in counter-drone capabilities over the next five years and plans to train five times as many drone operators by the end of 2027.

stories.title: AirGyde and Speedbird Partner to Assess US drone Logistics Expansion
Doubling drone supplies and strengthening air defence: Ukraine outlines priorities to EU partners
stories.summary: Ukraine's Defence Minister Evgeniy Khmara told the EU Foreign Affairs Council in Brussels that Ukraine plans to double drone supplies in 2027, with drones accounting for more than half of its weapons needs. He proposed developing joint production projects in Europe and procuring drones using EU loan funds and bilateral assistance, while also seeking interceptor missiles for Patriot systems in exchange for new ones Ukraine has under contract.

stories.title: NASA, Cincinnati Students Spot Failing Drone Motors by Sound Alone
stories.summary: University of Cincinnati students and a NASA Ames researcher developed a preflight check that uses microphones and a machine-learning model to detect failing drone motors by sound, reporting 97% precision and 92% recall at the 2026 Modeling, Estimation and Control Conference in Phoenix.

stories.title: The US Army Has a Problem: One of Its Majors Says a Kuwait Base Had No Counter-Drone System When a Iran Shahed Killed 6
Friend or foe becomes the question as skies fill with potential adversaries
stories.summary: BAE Systems delivered more than 1,500 interrogators, 6,000 combined interrogator-transponder systems, and 16,000 transponders across 140 platform types in more than 40 countries since Mode 5’s introduction in the mid-2000s.

stories.title: Iranian air defences shoot down US-made LUCAS drone over Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary: Iranian Army air defense systems shot down a US-made LUCAS attack drone over the Strait of Hormuz, according to a statement carried by state broadcaster IRIB. Residents on Qeshm Island reported hearing explosions and seeing smoke, while US Central Command separately stated it intercepted multiple Iranian drones launched toward Bahrain without damage to US equipment.

stories.title: Amazon Asked Nampa Not to Share Its Drone Contact, City Official Says
stories.summary: Nampa, Idaho planning director Rodney Ashby told resident Judit Crace that Amazon requested the city keep its local drone complaint contact private and forward public concerns to that number instead. Ashby noted that the permit's Condition 5 requires Amazon to provide a local contact reachable within 72 hours, but he stated the wording does not promise a direct public contact.

stories.title: Amazon drone delivery begins in metro Atlanta
stories.summary: Amazon Prime Air began drone deliveries in metro Atlanta this past weekend, starting in Gwinnett County. The service offers delivery in under an hour for items under 5 pounds within a 7.5-mile radius of the facility.

also.title: Amazon Drones Reach Atlanta With No Georgia File on the FAA Index

stories.title: A Ukrainian naval drone maker was surprised by the targets they hunt
stories.summary: Ukraine's Magura naval drones have taken out Russian targets at sea, helicopters in the air, and air defense systems on land, surprising founder and CEO Oleg Rogynskyy. He predicts that "pretty much every navy on the planet is going to be scaling itself using cheap, attritable, unmanned assets that are AI-controlled."

also.title: Ukraine’s Magura drone boats have downed Russian helicopters and taken out air defenses. The maker didn’t see that coming.

stories.title: Rapyuta Robotics Partners with Numina Group to Expand U.S. Adoption of Goods-to-Person ASRS Automation
stories.summary: Rapyuta Robotics named Numina Group its first U.S. systems integrator to expand Goods-to-Person automation. Numina selected Rapyuta's latest-generation robotic system for several warehouse projects going live in 2027.

stories.title: US Navy tests GPS-free camera navigation system on ScanEagle drone over open ocean
stories.summary: The US Navy tested a camera-based navigation system on a ScanEagle drone near San Clemente Island, completing a six-hour flight over open ocean without GPS signals. Developed by Rhoman Aerospace and the Naval Postgraduate School, the system achieved less than 0.5 percent navigation drift and will next integrate with AeroVironment's JUMP 20 UAV.

stories.title: DHS S&T advances counter-drone capabilities
Royal Navy Commissions First Autonomous Squadron
stories.summary: The UK’s Royal Navy commissioned its first autonomous squadron on November 5 at His Majesty’s Naval Base Portsmouth to test unmanned naval craft. The unit comprises around 180 personnel and operates vessels including the Kraken and Rattler, supporting a £1.5 billion four-year investment in the navy’s hybrid plan.

stories.title: Uber and Zipline’s drone delivery service takes flight in Houston
stories.summary: Uber Eats launched drone delivery in Spring, Texas, on Tuesday, partnering with Zipline to lower food orders from Jersey Mike’s, Zaxby’s, and local restaurants into customer yards via tethered pods. The service operates daily from 8AM to 10PM, with Dallas next in line and a goal of 1 million daily deliveries by the end of 2029.

stories.title: Canadian investors give Toronto company $40 million to help robots build more homes
stories.summary: Toronto-based Promise Robotics Inc. closed a $40-million Series B fundraising round led by London-based White Star Capital LLC. The company said the funds will expand its production networks in North America and grow its teams in Canada and the U.S. to 100-plus.

Germany Bans Operational Use of Chinese-Made Drones
stories.summary: The German military banned the operational use of Chinese-made drones, restricting them strictly to training and target-interception drills. Berlin reversed a 2024 strategy that had permitted the procurement of DJI drones under special authorizations, citing concerns over sensitive data exposure and foreign surveillance.

stories.title: Robotics PLI, R&D tax incentives should be key Budget 2027-28 considerations: Industry body
stories.summary: ASSOCHAM proposed that the government introduce a dedicated production-linked incentive scheme for robotics and restore enhanced tax incentives for research and development in the Union Budget 2027-28. The industry body also recommended allowing electric vehicles to be registered without batteries and providing a 3 per cent interest subvention for MSME fleet owners.

stories.title: U.S. Army Selects Xtremis for AUGUR SHIELD Contract to Advance Counter-Drone Defense
stories.summary: Xtremis announced it has been awarded a contract supporting the U.S. Army Combat Capabilities Development Command Army Research Laboratory under the AUGUR SHIELD initiative. The multi-year effort aims to develop advanced electromagnetic spectrum capabilities to detect and mitigate unmanned aerial system threats.

stories.title: Can Archer's Texas Air Taxi Networks Expand Its Market Reach?
stories.summary: Archer Aviation Inc. unveiled proposed air taxi networks across Houston, Dallas-Fort Worth and Austin, TX, aiming to reduce 60-90-minute road journeys to 10-20-minute flights using its all-electric Midnight aircraft. The company plans to connect major airports and business districts, including routes to Galveston and the F1 Circuit Helipad, while pursuing operations under the White House's eVTOL Integration Pilot Program.

stories.title: Ukraine’s drone war never belonged to Fedorov, says defence entrepreneur
stories.summary: Fedir Serdiuk, co-founder of defence company MOWA, told EU Perspectives that Ukraine is ready to join Europe’s defence market but lacks practical integration tracks. He noted that 80 per cent of wounded soldiers on the front lines are now hit by drones, and he urged Western nations to extract lessons from Ukraine’s battlefields to update their defence doctrines.

stories.title: Howard County, Maryland Expands Public Safety Drone Operations with Axon Air DFR Program
stories.summary: Howard County Police Department is expanding its public safety technology capabilities by adopting Axon Air Drone as First Responder, Skydio X10 drones, Dedrone counter-UAS technology, and integrated real-time operations software. The department is also adopting Fusus real-time operations platform, TASER 10 energy weapons, body-worn cameras, and in-car video systems to improve situational awareness and operational coordination.

stories.title: Railway traffic between Hungary and Ukraine suspended after Russian drone attack on western Ukraine
stories.summary: Hungary suspended railway traffic to and from Ukraine on Tuesday and Wednesday after a Russian drone crashed 300 metres from the Mukachevo railway station in Zakarpattia, according to Prime Minister Peter Magyar.

stories.title: Volz Servos Supports Singapore’s First Homegrown eVTOL Aircraft Development
stories.summary: Volz Servos supplied flight control actuators for Nanyang Technological University's first domestically designed electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft. The program completed a month-long flight testing campaign in summer 2026 at the German Aerospace Center's National Experimental Test Center for Unmanned Aircraft Systems in Germany.

stories.title: U.S. Army tests Northrop’s counter-drone gun truck
Carmeuse on its new autonomous Cat 777 fleet and the bigger picture
stories.summary: Carmeuse converted five Caterpillar 777 haul trucks to autonomous operation at its Drummond Island quarry in northern Michigan, achieving its first autonomous load and haul cycle in April 2026. The project addresses staffing challenges for 24/7 operations and serves as a strategic pilot to validate the technology for broader deployment across the company's 66 global quarries.

stories.title: New rail transport standard for lithium batteries implemented
stories.summary: China implemented a new industry standard for transporting lithium batteries by rail on Nov 1, setting technical requirements for packaging, labeling, and emergency response. The National Railway Administration of China said the rule aims to improve safety and capacity, diversify transport options beyond road and sea, and support stable industrial supply chains.

stories.title: Durabook Launches Rugged Ground Control Stations for Drones
stories.summary: Durabook introduced a Ground Control Station portfolio for unmanned systems, featuring 8-inch and 10-inch tablet controllers and a 14-inch laptop platform. The Windows-based solutions support WinTAK and Linux, offering configurable joysticks, switches, and radio options for aerial, ground, and maritime operations.

stories.title: Big Bang Boom Solutions Launches the Vajra Sind, a True Wideband Handheld RF Jammer for Counter-Drone Defence
stories.summary: Big Bang Boom Solutions unveiled Vajra Sind, a handheld RF jammer offering wideband jamming from 400 MHz to 6 GHz, during a visit by Major General Roopesh Mehta in Chennai. The system weighs under 5 kg and was conceptualized after Operation Sindoor to provide soldiers with portable counter-drone capabilities.

stories.title: Black Sea: Greek-owned vessel Gas Husky sinks amid reports of drone attack
UAV DACH warns against weakening Europe’s drone industry
stories.summary: The European Association for Unmanned Aviation (UAV DACH) issued a statement on 17 November criticising the European Commission’s planned European Trusted Drone Label (ETDL). The association says the current draft does not include the requirement that at least 75 percent of drones and their components originate from European companies, and calls on Commission President von der Leyen to rectify this.

also.title: UAV DACH Says EU Drone Label Drops 75% European Content Rule

stories.title: France Moves to Restore Long-Range Army Reconnaissance With Tekever AR5 Drones
stories.summary: France selected Tekever to supply five AR5 tactical drone systems to restore long-range reconnaissance capabilities delayed by the Patroller program. The framework agreement, valued at approximately €150 million, is expected to be signed before the end of 2026.

stories.title: Kanpur Express: Daily service to Delhi launched; Vaishnaw announces more rail infra projects
stories.summary: Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw launched the daily Kanpur Express connecting Kanpur Central with Delhi's Anand Vihar Terminal. He also announced a 16-km elevated track and the proposed Bullet Train North Corridor, which could cut Delhi-Kanpur travel time to 1 hour and 45 minutes.

stories.title: Rail Signalling Systems Market Momentum: Advancing Railway Safety Through Intelligent Train Control Technologi
stories.summary: The global rail signalling systems market was valued at USD 17.19 billion in 2025 and is projected to reach USD 28.28 billion by 2033, expanding at a CAGR of 6.4%.

stories.title: Penguin Random House doubles book picking productivity with Locus Robotics
stories.summary: Penguin Random House Grupo Editorial scaled its Locus Robotics environment from 14 robots to 40 robots managing nearly 1,000 SKU locations. The site now handles more than one and a half million units per month with picking productivity of more than 510 units per hour.

stories.title: Dutch-Swedish team introduce acoustic drone detection system
stories.summary: Dutch defence technology company BeephoniX is teaming up with Swedish specialist Bertin Exensor to co-develop Orbis, an acoustic drone detection sensor integrated into the Flexnet surveillance platform. The system uses passive acoustic sensing to identify, classify, and track low-flying drones, detecting 7-inch FPV drones up to 150 metres away with a battery life of up to 30 days.

stories.title: U.S. Transportation Secretary Duffy Flies Jetson ONE Personal eVTOL at NASA's Kennedy Space Center; Aircraft Stays Under FAA Part 103 Ultralight Rule
First Tellurium Announces Completion of Upgraded Heavy-Lift Drone Prototype
stories.summary: First Tellurium Corp. announced that PyroDelta Energy completed an upgraded 50-pound heavy-lift drone prototype designed to carry a minimum 150-pound payload. The aircraft uses liquid fuel for greater range and is being prepared for flight and thrust testing in Florida.

stories.title: Eve’s Vector System Manages More Than 100 Helicopter Flights In One Day at Interlagos
BAE Systems develops new “ghost radar” to detect airborne threats
stories.summary: BAE Systems developed a covert radar that detects airborne threats using existing TV and radio broadcasts without revealing its position. The company said the low-cost system will undergo live trials with partners throughout 2027.

also.title: BAE Systems develops ‘Ghost Radar’ that detects drones without giving away its position

stories.title: EHang unveils pilotless eVTOL for aerial firefighting
stories.summary: Chinese aircraft manufacturer EHang unveiled the EH216-EK, a pilotless electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) aircraft designed for early-stage aerial firefighting. The first batch has completed assembly at the Wencheng Smart Manufacturing Center, though EHang has not announced a timetable for operational deployment or disclosed whether the aircraft has secured regulatory approvals.

stories.title: Russia Unveils More Powerful Depesha-MK Ground Robot for Frontline Supply in Ukraine
stories.summary: Russia's state defense group Rostec unveiled the upgraded Depesha-MK unmanned ground vehicle on November 16, 2026, to expand frontline battlefield logistics in Ukraine. The platform features a larger cargo compartment and more powerful electric motors to haul heavier supplies and reduce risky troop resupply trips under constant drone surveillance.

stories.title: Nokia Federal to support US 5G/6G drone detection project
stories.summary: Nokia Federal Solutions won a contract to develop and test integrated sensing and communications capabilities for the US Department of Defense’s RAPID project. The effort uses 5G and 6G infrastructure to detect and track unmanned aerial systems threats, supporting the DoD’s FutureG Office in protecting critical infrastructure.

stories.summary: Tesla invited select customers to purchase its two-seat Cybercab for $29,900, with delivery scheduled for December. The vehicle will not operate without a $299 monthly autonomy subscription, which Tesla can suspend for safety, security, or connectivity issues.

stories.title: Royal Navy to test launch autonomous jet from aircraft carrier in 2027
stories.summary: The Royal Navy will work with Northrop Grumman to launch the company's Talon autonomous jet demonstrator from an aircraft carrier in British waters in 2027. First Sea Lord General Sir Gwyn Jenkins announced the plan on Tuesday, November 10, aboard HMS Prince of Wales in Oslo, Norway.

stories.summary: Alstom and Talgo revealed details of their trainset proposals for a contract to supply 12 high-speed trains to national operator CP.

stories.title: ‘The threat is very real’: Unidentified drones reported over Canadian military bases as recently as 2025
stories.summary: CTVNews.ca obtained reports detailing seven unauthorized drone sightings at CFB Trenton and CFB Cold Lake in 2024 and 2025, noting that operators were never identified and no interception attempts were made. A counter-drone system at CFB Trenton failed to detect a drone on Sept. 22, 2025, while CFB Cold Lake stated it lacks means to track small unmanned aircraft.

stories.title: British Army reservists target replica Russian and Iranian attack drones in Finland exercise
stories.summary: British Army reservists fired missiles at replicas of Russian and Iranian attack drones during Exercise Mallet Strike 2/26 in Finland. Personnel from 106 Regiment Royal Artillery participated alongside forces from Finland, Sweden, and Norway from November 10 to 19.

stories.title: Russian drone strikes police patrol vehicle in Sumy Oblast, injuring two officers – photos
stories.summary: A Russian fibre-optic-controlled UAV struck a police patrol vehicle in Hlukhiv, Sumy Oblast, on the morning of 17 November, injuring two officers aged 33 and 23 with blast injuries and shrapnel wounds. Both officers were taken to hospital, and the vehicle was left unfit for use.

stories.title: New Virginia Tech center to help protect rail lines critical to military operations
stories.summary: Virginia Tech has been selected to receive up to $7.51 million in funding from the Federal Railroad Administration to establish the National Defense Rail Resilience Center. The center will focus on the Strategic Rail Corridor Network (STRACNET), approximately 41,000 miles of track connecting roughly 140 military installations, depots, and ports to the national rail system.

stories.title: GXO Eyes 1,000 Apollo Humanoids Ahead of Warehouse Trials
stories.summary: GXO Logistics and Apptronik announced a letter of intent on Nov. 12 to expand real-world trials starting in 2027, targeting initial North American deployments in late 2027. The partners aim for a possible global rollout of up to 1,000 robots over four years if they meet jointly agreed productivity, safety, and operational targets.

stories.title: Ukrainian Tencore showcases AI-powered evacuation ground robot in Netherlands
stories.summary: Ukrainian company Tencore demonstrated an armoured unmanned ground vehicle (UGV) for casualty evacuation at the European Defence Innovation Forum in The Hague. The platform features autonomous control elements powered by artificial intelligence (AI) and allows operators to maintain contact with wounded personnel via a remote communication system.

stories.title: Seven industry partners selected for DoD JIATF 401 directed energy evaluation
stories.summary: The US defence department’s Office of Research and Engineering and Joint Interagency Task Force 401 invited seven industry partners to Phase II of a Directed Energy Counter-Unmanned Aerial Systems evaluation. A live-fire test at Dugway Proving Ground is planned for mid-December, following November safety certifications and technical reviews.

stories.title: Prince Harry meets Ukrainian soldier rescued from battlefield by drone
stories.summary: Prince Harry met Ukrainian soldier Kostiantyn Vlasenko at the Superhumans rehabilitation center during the prince's visit to the country, the center said on Nov. 16. Vlasenko was evacuated from the battlefield by a heavy-lift drone after suffering devastating injuries.

stories.title: Aselsan's Ejderha downs 51-drone swarm in seconds without a single missile
stories.summary: Aselsan's Ejderha high-power electromagnetic counter-drone system neutralized 51 drones simultaneously within seconds in a record test, which CEO Ahmet Akyol described as a world first. The upgraded Ejderha/AD 210, unveiled at the SAHA 2026 exhibition in Istanbul, took down the swarm in a single pulse.

stories.title: ROBOTERA Expands Humanoid Robot Deployment Across China Post's Guangdong Network, Reaching Eight Cities Province-Wide
stories.summary: ROBOTERA deployed humanoid robots across 11 postal hubs in eight Guangdong cities, marking the largest-scale logistics deployment to date. The robots process over 1,500 parcels per hour, matching experienced human workers, and are jointly implemented with China Post Group Guangdong Branch.

stories.title: Tesla Wants to Produce 1 Million Cybercab Robotaxis a Year in Europe, but There's One Problem
stories.summary: Tesla plans to invest €3 billion in a new building at its Gigafactory near Berlin to produce up to 1 million Cybercab robotaxis annually by 2029. André Thierig, head of Tesla's German factory, announced construction will begin in the first half of 2027, though EU regulations currently limit fully driverless vehicle registrations to 1,500 per type annually.

stories.title: Seven Drones, Five Drones, and Not One Confirmed: The Lakenheath Drone Panic
stories.summary: Suffolk Constabulary logs record unverified drone sightings over RAF Lakenheath, Mildenhall, and Feltwell in November 2024, with patrols unable to locate or identify the objects. The article notes that similar misidentifications of ordinary aircraft as drones occurred at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base and Copenhagen Airport.

stories.title: ​Ukrainian Sargan 3000 USV Destroys russian Unmanned Boat in Rare Naval Drone Duel (Video)
stories.summary: The Ukrainian Navy released footage on November 16 showing a Sargan 3000 unmanned surface vessel destroying a Russian counterpart during a nighttime engagement. The Ukrainian vessel used a remotely operated automatic turret to hit the Russian boat, which the Navy attributed to operator skill despite challenging conditions.

stories.title: China Details GJ-11 Stealth Drone’s Strike and Reconnaissance Capabilities
stories.summary: China detailed the GJ-11 stealth drone's strike and reconnaissance capabilities in new military television coverage, describing its internal weapons storage and potential use against ground and maritime targets. The aircraft, first displayed in October 2019, reportedly achieved a first-round hit during live-fire training, with military commentator Zhang Xuefeng claiming it attained combat capability.

stories.title: Tech leaders say EV innovation, robotaxis key for Apec
stories.summary: CATL founder Robin Zeng and Baidu chief executive Robin Li told the Apec CEO Summit in Shenzhen that electric vehicle innovation and robotaxis are key for the Asia-Pacific region. Zeng highlighted battery swapping technology that allows cars to swap batteries in 99 seconds, while Li noted that robotaxis have a safety record about 10 times better than human drivers.

stories.title: Ukraine’s SPYS Interceptor Drone Adapted for UAV Launch
stories.summary: Ukrainian company Quantum WIY Industries adapted its SPYS interceptor drone for deployment from carrier UAVs at altitudes of up to 3–4 kilometers. The company is currently testing the air-launch capability using dedicated SPYS prototypes while developing universal integration solutions for various UAVs.

stories.title: Railway. Powered by Precision: ASC Brings German Sensor Technology to InnoRail India
stories.summary: ASC Sensors will exhibit high-precision inertial sensor solutions at InnoRail India 2026 in Lucknow from November 26-28. The company participates in the German Pavilion, supported by the Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Energy, to present technologies for railway safety and maintenance.

stories.title: Russia Claims Record Ukrainian Drone Attack for Second Day in a Row, Reports 1,441 Interceptions
stories.summary: Russia claimed its air defense systems intercepted 1,441 Ukrainian drones overnight on November 17, in what Russian media described as the largest overnight drone attack on the country since the beginning of its full-scale invasion of Ukraine.

stories.title: First of a Kind rail projects announced
stories.summary: The Department for Transport and Innovate UK announced 23 First of a Kind 2026 winners who will receive funding to develop novel rail technologies. The projects address challenges in economic growth, safety, reliability, and environmental impact, with outcomes showcased through live demonstrations in operational environments.

stories.title: Tesla may test customer-owned cars in its Robotaxi network as soon as December, Musk says
stories.summary: Elon Musk said on X that Tesla may start trials next month to put customer-owned cars into its Robotaxi network. Tesla has not published a program, specified which cars or cities would qualify, or explained how owners would share fares.

stories.title: Portal North Bridge Opens, Replacing 116-Year-Old Rail Bridge
stories.summary: New Jersey Governor Mikie Sherrill joined NJ TRANSIT and Amtrak officials in Kearny to celebrate the completion of the Portal North Bridge. Both tracks on the new bridge are now in full service following a successful five-week cutover process.

stories.title: Kodiak signs up carrier for driverless trucks
stories.summary: Kodiak AI signed a 75-truck deal with DTL Transport to equip its fleet with self-driving trucks on Dallas-El Paso and Dallas-Atlanta corridors, targeting a 2028 launch. The company plans its first driverless highway service before the end of the year, carrying freight for IKEA between Houston and Dallas.

stories.title: Dream of the Desert ultra-luxury train to launch in October 2027
stories.summary: Arsenale International and Saudi Arabia Railways opened bookings for the Dream of the Desert, described as the world’s first ultra-luxury desert journey by train.

stories.title: Saronic to develop autonomous logistics vessel for US Marine Corps
stories.summary: Saronic Technologies received a prototype Other Transaction agreement from the Defense Innovation Unit to deliver its autonomous low-profile vessel for the US Marine Corps. The vessel will transport supplies to dispersed forces, utilizing autonomy technology tested over more than 350,000 nautical miles and 55,000 hours of operation.

also.title: U.S. Marine Corps to receive Saronic’s autonomous low profile vessel

stories.title: Another merchant ship lost in Black Sea drone onslaught
stories.summary: The Somali-flagged Betul 8 capsized in Bulgaria’s exclusive economic zone after crewmembers told Bulgarian journalists that two naval drones struck it, killing no one as all 12 crewmembers were rescued. Bulgarian authorities have yet to confirm the cause or establish who was responsible.

stories.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guards claimed a drone strike on a US-operated radar system at Sheikh Isa Air Base in Bahrain on Tuesday morning. Explosions were heard in Manama after residents received mobile-phone alerts warning of a potential threat.

stories.title: Patna to Varanasi in 1 hour? Bullet Train to connect Delhi, Patna and Guwahati; Check route and expected travel time
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi reportedly approved the Northern Bullet Train Corridor, a 1,500-kilometre high-speed rail line connecting Delhi to Guwahati. Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw announced the route will reduce the Delhi-Siliguri journey from 20 hours to six, with Varanasi-Patna travel expected to take one hour.

Cerberon and Dynamit Nobel Defense Test Modular Drone Weapon System
stories.summary: Cerberon Defence Systems and Dynamit Nobel Defence successfully tested their Modular Lethality Kit under flight conditions for the first time in a controlled DND test bunker. The retrofittable module, which combines a warhead with electronic safety devices, is designed to transform drone platforms into loitering munitions in accordance with relevant NATO security standards. The companies stated that the next step will focus on integrating the MLK into various drone platforms.

stories.title: Toyota Launches Full-Scale Level 4 Robotaxi Public Service in Guangzhou, China
stories.summary: Pony.ai and Toyota launched a public Level 4 robotaxi service in Guangzhou, China, using mass-produced seventh-generation bZ4X vehicles. This expansion allows the companies to operate in all four major tier-1 cities in China: Beijing, Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Guangzhou.

also.title: Robotaxi service in China leaps forward with latest collaboration

stories.title: SkyDrive Partners with Gold Coast to Advance eVTOL Deployment
stories.summary: SkyDrive signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the City of Gold Coast to explore eVTOL feasibility, following an August 2026 Letter of Intent with Gold Coast Helitours. The partnership aims to launch commercial operations in 2028 using five SD-05 aircraft, with vertiports planned near Gold Coast Airport and Marina Mirage.

also.title: SkyDrive Partners with Gold Cost on Australian eVTOL Development and Ecosystem Plans

stories.title: FBI – Seeking information, drone in restricted airspace
stories.summary: The FBI’s Field Office in Washington, D.C., is seeking information regarding individuals who allegedly flew a drone in restricted airspace near Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport on or about October 29, 2026. The activity impacted airport operations and may violate federal laws punishable by fines, imprisonment for not more than one year, or both.

also.title: FBI Seeks Names in Alleged Drone Flight Beside Reagan National

stories.title: Eurostar appoints Newrest to run onboard catering and lounges
stories.summary: Eurostar selected Newrest to operate onboard catering and lounge services across its network, including Eurostar Plus, Eurostar Premier, Eurostar Café, and five lounges in Brussels, London, and Paris.

stories.title: AIR Brings Autonomous Cargo Aircraft to Florida for Flight Demonstrations
stories.summary: Israeli aerospace company AIR brought its autonomous AIR 120D cargo aircraft to the United States for the first time to conduct flight demonstrations at its Florida headquarters. The electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft carries approximately 550 pounds of cargo in a 70-cubic-foot compartment and does not require a runway.

stories.title: Waymo’s expansion highlights the future of autonomous ride services
stories.summary: Waymo returned to The Bluff this fall and secured financing to expand its self-driving ride service across the United States and internationally. The company states its services are safer than human drivers, though some experts claim the vehicles’ technology has room for improvement.
